pages.en:
“—It’s over, and I don’t care about it anymore. My wounds healed, and you let me go in the end.

“…If it still bothers you, I promise I’ll never mention it again. Will that be enough?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I’m over it. My wound healed up, and you let me go.
…But I won’t bring it up again if it bothers you. Is that okay?”

pages.ja:
「ぁ……うん。じゃあ、シロウは怒ってない……？」
「ああ。自分でもどうかと思うけど、怒ってない。
それより今は、もっとイリヤと話したい」
pages.jaRuby:
「ぁ……うん。じゃあ、シロウは怒ってない……？」

pages.en:
“Ah… yes. Then you aren’t angry, Shirou…?”

“No. I’m not angry, however strange that may be.

“Right now, I’d rather learn more about you.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh… yeah. Um, so you’re not mad, Shirou…?”
“I probably should be mad, but I’m not for some reason.
Actually, I want to talk to you now.”

pages.en:
The face poised upon the brink of tears blossoms instantly into a smile.

“————”

The sight makes me happy as well.

There is no hostility in Illya now.

Then there is no need to force her into the role of a Master.

Now that she has caught me, I may as well relax and talk for as long as she wants—
pages.mirrorMoon:
She was about to cry, but now she smiles.
“”
That smile makes me happy as well.
I don’t feel any hostility from her.
Then I should stop thinking like a Master.
I guess I’ll have to talk with her, just like she wants
